reason: Modelled from the M5Stack U027 schematic: the button pulls OUT to GND, a 10k-to-5V / 20k-to-GND divider gives about 3.3 V when released (active low, levelV 3.3). The Grove order is OUT/NC/5V/GND. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
breakoutPinoutSource: M5Stack U027 schematic J1 (pin1 I, 2 O/NC, 3 VCC, 4 GND) plus wire colours from https://docs.m5stack.com/en/unit/button
